RunSubmission.description: Immutable, secret-free native-v2 submission admitted by the selected target.

RunSubmitParams.description:
Trusted controller bootstrap admission. The host assigns the only public run identity before
controller start; the immutable submission remains identity-neutral.

RuntimeEnvironment.description:
Setup runs as root before checkout; startup runs as the workspace user after checkout or restore.
Both hooks run again on a new attempt. Values here are public run configuration, never secrets.

connections.description: Exact connection fields available to setup and startup, separate from node credentials.
